rundown: Green Wave beat Black Bears 70-62 at Ocean Center in Daytona Beach, FL. Green Wave led 34-30 at the half and never looked back. The 3rd quarter decided it: Green Wave won it 22-16. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 80%).
Leading the way — Black Bears: Kaliyah Sain 26 pts; Maddie Fitzpatrick 5 ast; Lizzy Gruber 8 reb. Green Wave: Nataliyah Gray 23 pts, 5 reb; Kennedy Simpson 4 ast.
Where Green Wave won it: they shot 53% to 40%, had 15 assists to 14 and turned it over 11 times to 18.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 28, 10:58 AM ET. It had Black Bears 16% and Green Wave 84%, projecting Black Bears 58.8 – Green Wave 71.7 (130.5 total, Green Wave by 12.9).

Final: Black Bears 62 – Green Wave 70. Right winner: it had Green Wave at 84%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Black Bears came in with a 2% below average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (4-3, 63.6 scored and 69.7 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 168 and 171 games of evidence. Projected to score 58.8, they scored 62 (+3.2 points, 5% over); projected to allow 71.7, they allowed 70 (−1.7 points, 2% under).

Green Wave came in with a 2% above average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (5-1, 81 scored and 53.7 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 169 and 169 games of evidence. Projected to score 71.7, they scored 70 (−1.7 points, 2% under); projected to allow 58.8, they allowed 62 (+3.2 points, 5% over).

The bigger miss was Black Bears' scoring (+3.2 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 132 against 130.5 projected (+1.5), about the 54th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Green Wave by 8 against Green Wave by 12.9 projected, about the 35th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.982 of the raw projection. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1198 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.971 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Black Bears attack ×0.978, defense ×1.003 (8 games); Green Wave attack ×1.032, defense ×0.980 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
